tech.title: Light of true value, built on technology and quality
tech.lead: Every installation environment is different, and so is the technology applied. The points below apply only to the products for which the specification is stated in our catalog.

items.title: Low-power operation
items.desc: Low-power operation and an energy-saving function provide a long service life.
items.scope: Ø138 road stud, battery and hybrid types — up to 3 years of use

items.title: Solar & hybrid power
items.desc: Solar and hybrid (solar + battery) power options allow easy installation without wiring.
items.scope: Park security lights, recessed floor lights, fence post lights, accent lighting — 5 days or more without sunlight

items.title: Shockproof, waterproof, dustproof
items.desc: Ingress protection is designed per product for road and outdoor environments.
items.scope: IP68: road studs (Ø138, replacement module), curb stone lighting, recessed floor lights, fence post lights / IP65: logo projector, park light, bollard light

items.title: Replaceable module structure
items.desc: Only the internal module is replaced while the fixture stays in place, reducing maintenance costs.
items.scope: Ø138 LED road stud and replacement modules

items.title: Lighting tailored to the site
items.desc: Custom lengths, adjustable angles, bracket options and color effects to suit site conditions.
items.scope: LED linear light, LED linear floodlight, LED circle floodlight

items.title: Direct production & quality control
items.desc: Manufacturing and quality are managed in-house, backed by factory registration, direct production certificates and a dedicated R&D department.
items.scope: Direct production certificates: road studs, LED landscape lighting fixtures

greeting.title: CEO Message | GreenOne Co., Ltd.
greeting.description: A message from Moon Ji-won, CEO of GreenOne Co., Ltd. — your most trusted partner in light and safety.
greeting.headline: Safety Illuminated by Light, Urban Excellence Elevated by Technology
paragraphs: GreenOne Co., Ltd. is a specialized manufacturer of road studs and landscape lighting, dedicated to creating safer roads for people and more beautiful nightscapes for cities.

We understand that even a small road marker or a single light illuminating a street can help protect someone's precious everyday life and shape the overall impression of a city. With this responsibility in mind, we have gone beyond simply manufacturing lighting structures, continuously pursuing rigorous quality control and technological innovation to create "Light of True Value."

Combining the meticulous perspective of a women-owned business with an unwavering commitment to technical craftsmanship, we strive to provide optimal solutions tailored to the ever-changing urban environment. Our catalog reflects both our confidence in our technology and our sincere commitment to our customers.
As your most trusted partner in light and safety, GreenOne Co., Ltd. will always be by your side.
